title: On Mahler $U$-numbers under rational maps
summary: In 1906, Maillet proved that every nonconstant rational function over $\mathbb{Q}$ maps Liouville numbers to Liouville numbers. Let $R$ be a nonconstant rational function with real algebraic coefficients, of degree $d$, and let $e$ be the degree of its minimal field of definition over $\mathbb{Q}$. We prove that, for every $m\geq 1$, the possible types of $R(ξ)$, as $ξ$ ranges over $U$-numbers of type $m$, are exactly the integers $r$ with $\lceil m/(ed)\rceil\leq r\leq em$.
